set.overviewBody: Your strength: trusting God and stepping forward even when you can't see the whole road. Your challenge: in long seasons of waiting, doubt sets in and you try to force the outcome yourself. Inside, how to hold onto faith and peace while you wait.

set.shareLine: Only 11% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: faithfulness that keeps going through the longest, hardest seasons. Your challenge: a quiet voice keeps asking who am I? and you feel you're never quite enough. Inside, how to walk in your calling even when you don't feel ready.

set.shareLine: Only 13% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: an honest, wholehearted heart that holds nothing back from God. Your challenge: your highs run high and your lows run low, and feelings can take the wheel. Inside, how to bring your whole heart to God without being swept away by it.

set.shareLine: Only 45% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: deep conviction and drive that move you, and everyone around you, forward. Your challenge: you push so hard that rest feels like failure, and burnout creeps up on you. Inside, how to keep your fire without letting it burn you out.

set.shareLine: Only 37% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: staying faithful and steady when everyone else walks away.  Your challenge: you pour so much into others that you forget to ask what you need. Inside, how to love loyally without losing yourself.

set.shareLine: Only 14% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: a calm, surrendered heart that trusts deeply and stays steady under pressure. Your challenge: you carry too much in silence and rarely let anyone help you. Inside, how to stay at peace without carrying it all alone.

set.shareLine: Only 11% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: wisdom and clarity that others naturally turn to. Your challenge: you're always the strong one, and it's hard to rest or let someone carry you. Inside, how to lead without burning out, and let yourself be held too.

set.shareLine: Only 36% of people share your archetype
set.overviewBody: Your strength: quiet courage that shows up exactly when it's needed most. Your challenge: you hesitate at the edge of bold moments, waiting until you feel ready. Inside, how to use your voice before the moment passes.
